04 / A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Before you
make your move.

What is ZeroApply?+

ZeroApply is a desktop workspace for managing your professional profiles and job application workflow.

Which platforms are supported?+

Windows and macOS packaging are configured in the project. Public installers will appear here once a release is available. Linux availability has not been announced.

Can I download it right now?+

No public installer is connected yet. The download section shows the current availability for each platform and will offer a download when a release is published.

How do I get started?+

Choose your platform above. Once the installer is available, download it, install ZeroApply, and set up your profile in the desktop app.
